note: The educational back of a flashcard: a Persian meaning, and worked examples in which the conjugated form is named and can be heard. Tense ids are the ones in content/tense-names.json, which already carries their names in four languages, so nothing here invents a label. `form` is a LITERAL substring of its own `fr` sentence — tests/card-backs.test.js asserts that, because the screen highlights it by searching for it.
reviewNote: DRAFTED, NOT REVIEWED. The French and the Persian here were written by the agent that built this file. No teacher has read any of it and no Persian reader has checked the translations; `review.owner` and `review.teacher` are null on every entry and the card says so on screen. The Persian aims at the natural meaning of the sentence, not at French word order.

sources.fr-core-a1: content/fr-core-a1.json — the 22 written cards. Their Persian meanings and their two example sentences are REUSED verbatim here, with the same licence. Only the présent example is new, and the `form` strings were widened from the bare participle to the whole verb group so that the auxiliary is highlighted with it.

v:etre.usage: Être is the verb of identity and state, and it is the auxiliary of the verbs of movement and of every pronominal verb.

examples.fr: Demain, je serai à la maison.
examples.en: Tomorrow I will be at home.

v:avoir.usage: Avoir is also the auxiliary of most verbs in the passé composé.

examples.fr: J'ai eu une bonne idée ce matin.
examples.en: I had a good idea this morning.

v:aller.usage: Aller takes être in the passé composé, so its participle agrees with the subject: elle est allée.

examples.en: We are going to the market.

examples.fr: Je suis allé à Paris la semaine dernière.
examples.en: I went to Paris last week.

examples.fa: او دوشنبه به مدرسه خواهد رفت.
examples.en: She will go to school on Monday.

examples.fr: Nous avons fait les courses samedi.
examples.en: We did the shopping on Saturday.

examples.fr: Je ferai la cuisine ce soir.
Je n'ai pas pu venir hier.

examples.fa: فردا می‌توانی به من زنگ بزنی.
examples.en: You will be able to call me tomorrow.

examples.fa: باید این فرم را پر کنید.
examples.en: You will have to fill in this form.

examples.fa: او به من حقیقت را گفت.
فردا همه چیز را به تو خواهم گفت.
examples.en: I will tell you everything tomorrow.
I can see the sea from here.

examples.fr: Nous avons vu un bon film.

v:prendre.usage: With a means of transport, prendre is the ordinary verb: prendre le bus, prendre le train.

examples.fr: Elle prend le bus tous les matins.
examples.fa: او هر روز صبح با اتوبوس می‌رود.
examples.en: She takes the bus every morning.

examples.fr: J'ai pris le train de huit heures.
examples.en: I took the eight o'clock train.
We will have a coffee together.

examples.fr: Nous parlerons de ce projet lundi.
examples.fa: دوشنبه درباره‌ی این پروژه صحبت خواهیم کرد.
examples.en: We will talk about this project on Monday.

v:manger.usage: Manger keeps the e of its stem before a and o, so that the g stays soft: nous mangeons.

v:commencer.usage: Commencer takes a cedilla before a and o, so that the c stays soft: nous commençons.

examples.fr: Le film commence à huit heures.
Il a commencé à travailler en janvier.
examples.fa: او در ژانویه شروع به کار کرد.

examples.fr: Le cours commencera à neuf heures.
examples.fa: کلاس ساعت نه شروع خواهد شد.
examples.en: The class will start at nine.

examples.fr: Je finis mon travail à cinq heures.
examples.fa: کارم را ساعت پنج تمام می‌کنم.
examples.en: I finish my work at five.

examples.fr: J'ai fini de lire ce livre.
examples.fa: خواندن این کتاب را تمام کردم.

examples.fr: Elle finira son travail ce soir.
examples.fa: او کارش را امشب تمام خواهد کرد.
examples.en: She will finish her work this evening.

v:savoir.usage: In the passé composé, savoir usually means found out rather than knew. For the continuing state, French uses the imparfait: je savais.

examples.fa: دیروز از این خبر باخبر شدم.
examples.en: I found out the news yesterday.

v:venir.usage: Venir takes être in the passé composé, so the participle agrees: elle est venue.

examples.fa: هیچ‌کس حرفت را باور نخواهد کرد.

v:aimer.usage: With a person, aimer alone means to love; aimer bien softens it to to like.

examples.fa: این شهر را دوست خواهی داشت.

v:falloir.usage: Falloir exists only in the third person singular, with an il that stands for nobody. There is no je faux and no nous fallons, so these three examples are the whole verb rather than one person out of six.

examples.fr: Il a fallu attendre une heure.
examples.fa: مجبور شدیم یک ساعت صبر کنیم.
examples.en: We had to wait an hour.
It will be necessary to book.

v:penser.usage: Penser à is to have something in mind; penser de is to have an opinion of it.

examples.fr: Nous avons pensé à une solution.

examples.fa: بعداً به آن فکر خواهد کرد.
examples.en: He will think about it later.

v:attendre.usage: Attendre takes its object directly: on attend le bus, with no preposition.

examples.en: I am waiting for the bus.
She will wait in front of the station.

v:trouver.usage: With an adjective, trouver gives an opinion: je trouve ce livre intéressant.

examples.fa: این کتاب به نظرم جالب است.
خیابان را به‌راحتی پیدا خواهی کرد.
examples.en: You will find the street easily.

examples.fr: Je donne un cadeau à ma sœur.
examples.en: I am giving a present to my sister.

examples.fa: آدرس را به تو خواهم داد.
examples.en: I will give you the address.

v:souvenir.fa: به یاد آوردن، به یاد داشتن
v:souvenir.usage: Se souvenir exists only with its pronoun — there is no je souviens — and what is remembered follows de. It takes être in the passé composé, so the participle agrees: elle s'est souvenue.

examples.fr: Je me souviens de ce jour.
examples.fa: آن روز را به یاد دارم.

examples.fr: Elle s'est souvenue de mon nom.
Tu te souviendras de cette ville.
examples.fa: این شهر را به یاد خواهی داشت.

v:suivre.usage: Je suis is both suivre and être; the rest of the sentence decides. Suivre takes its object directly, and suivre un cours means to take a class.

examples.fr: Elle a suivi un cours de français.
examples.fa: او در یک کلاس فرانسه شرکت کرد.

v:passer.usage: Passer takes être in the passé composé when it has no object, so the participle agrees: elle est passée par Lyon. With an object it takes avoir and means to spend time: j'ai passé une semaine à Nice.

examples.en: We are walking past the station.

examples.fr: Je passerai chez toi ce soir.
examples.en: I will drop by your place tonight.

v:laisser.usage: Laisser is to leave something somewhere, and with an infinitive it is to let someone do something: laisser jouer les enfants.

examples.en: I am leaving my keys here.

examples.fr: Elle a laissé son sac à la maison.
examples.fa: او کیفش را در خانه جا گذاشت.
examples.en: She left her bag at home.
We will let the children play.

v:arriver.usage: Arriver takes être in the passé composé, so the participle agrees with the subject: elle est arrivée, ils sont arrivés.

examples.fr: J'arrive à la gare à huit heures.
examples.en: I arrive at the station at eight.

v:regarder.usage: Regarder takes its object directly, with no preposition: on regarde un film. It is to look or watch on purpose, where voir is simply to see.

examples.fa: از پنجره بیرون را نگاه کردم.
examples.en: I looked out of the window.

examples.fr: Vous regarderez la télé après le dîner.
examples.fa: بعد از شام تلویزیون تماشا خواهید کرد.
examples.en: You will watch TV after dinner.

v:appeler.usage: Appeler doubles its l before a silent ending: j'appelle and j'appellerai, but nous appelons.

examples.fr: J'appelle ma mère tous les soirs.
examples.fa: هر شب به مادرم زنگ می‌زنم.
examples.en: I call my mother every evening.

v:partir.usage: Partir takes être in the passé composé, so the participle agrees with the subject: elle est partie, ils sont partis. It is to leave or set off.

examples.fr: Je partirai en vacances en juillet.
examples.en: I will go on holiday in July.

v:mettre.usage: Mettre is to put something somewhere, and also to put on clothes.

examples.fr: Je mets le livre sur la table.
examples.en: I am putting the book on the table.

examples.fr: Nous mettrons la table à midi.
examples.en: We will set the table at noon.

v:rester.usage: Rester takes être in the passé composé, so the participle agrees with the subject: elle est restée, ils sont restés.

examples.fr: Je reste chez moi ce soir.
examples.en: I am staying at home tonight.

examples.fr: Les enfants sont restés à l'école.

examples.en: You will stay here until noon.

v:arrêter.usage: Arrêter is to stop something; arrêter de plus an infinitive is to stop doing it.

examples.fr: Il arrête la voiture devant la maison.
examples.fa: او ماشین را جلوی خانه نگه می‌دارد.
examples.en: He stops the car in front of the house.

examples.fr: Nous arrêterons le travail à midi.
examples.en: We will stop work at noon.

v:connaître.usage: Connaître is to know a person, a place or a thing; savoir is to know a fact or how to do something. In the passé composé it means to have met or got to know: il a connu sa femme à Lyon.

examples.fr: Il a connu sa femme à Lyon.
examples.fa: او در لیون با همسرش آشنا شد.
examples.en: He met his wife in Lyon.

examples.fa: به زودی شهر را خواهید شناخت.
examples.en: You will soon know the city.

v:tuer.usage: Tuer always has an object: something or someone is killed. It is not the verb for the one who dies, which is mourir.

examples.fr: Le froid a tué les plantes.
Le gel tuera les fleurs cette nuit.
examples.fa: امشب یخبندان گل‌ها را خواهد کشت.
examples.en: The frost will kill the flowers tonight.

v:mourir.usage: Mourir takes être in the passé composé, so the participle agrees with the subject: elle est morte, ils sont morts. It is irregular: il meurt, but nous mourons and ils meurent.

examples.en: This plant is dying of thirst.

examples.fr: Ma grand-mère est morte l'an dernier.

examples.en: The fish will die without water.

v:demander.usage: Demander is to ask a question or to ask for something. The person asked comes after à: je demande à Marie.

v:comprendre.usage: Comprendre is conjugated like prendre. It takes its object directly: je comprends la question.

examples.fr: Je ne comprends pas la question.
examples.en: I do not understand the question.

v:sortir.usage: Sortir without an object takes être in the passé composé, so the participle agrees with the subject: elle est sortie. With a direct object (to take something out) it takes avoir: il a sorti la voiture.

examples.fr: Elle est sortie de la maison à midi.
examples.fa: او ظهر از خانه بیرون رفت.
examples.en: She went out of the house at noon.

examples.fr: Je sortirai avec mes amis samedi.
examples.en: I will go out with my friends on Saturday.

v:entendre.usage: Entendre is to hear a sound whether or not you were paying attention; écouter is to listen on purpose.

examples.fa: موسیقی را از اینجا خواهی شنید.
examples.en: You will hear the music from here.

v:chercher.usage: Chercher takes its object directly, with no preposition: je cherche mes clés. Aller chercher is to go and get.

examples.en: I am looking for my keys.

examples.fr: Elle a cherché son sac partout.
examples.en: She looked for her bag everywhere.
We will look for a hotel tomorrow.

v:aider.usage: The person helped is a direct object: je l'aide. Before an infinitive the verb takes à: aider quelqu'un à porter.

examples.fr: Elle a aidé sa voisine à porter les sacs.
examples.fa: او به همسایه‌اش کمک کرد کیسه‌ها را ببرد.
examples.en: She helped her neighbour carry the bags.

v:essayer.usage: Essayer de plus an infinitive is to try to do something; with a thing as its object it is to try it or try it on. The y becomes i before a silent ending: j'essaie (j'essaye is also seen).

examples.en: I am trying on this jacket.

v:revenir.usage: Revenir is conjugated like venir and takes être in the passé composé, so the participle agrees with the subject: elle est revenue, ils sont revenus.

examples.en: I will be back in five minutes.
She will come back on Monday.

v:plaire.usage: Plaire turns the sentence round: the thing that pleases is the subject and the person is the indirect object, so ce film me plaît is literally 'this film pleases me'. S'il vous plaît is the polite 'please'.

examples.fr: Le cadeau a plu à ma mère.

examples.fa: از این گل‌ها خوشش خواهد آمد.
examples.en: He or she will like these flowers.

v:jouer.usage: Jouer à a game or sport (jouer au football) but jouer de an instrument (jouer de la guitare).

examples.fr: Les enfants jouent dans la cour.
examples.en: The children are playing in the yard.

examples.fr: Il a joué de la guitare hier soir.
examples.en: He played the guitar last night.

v:perdre.usage: Perdre is to lose something you cannot find, and also to lose a game or match, the opposite of gagner.

examples.fa: من همیشه گوشی‌ام را گم می‌کنم.

examples.fr: Notre équipe a perdu le match.

examples.en: They will build a house here.

examples.fa: این کتاب خیلی به شما کمک خواهد کرد.
examples.en: This book will help you a lot.
I drank a lot of water.

examples.fa: امروز صبح آب سرد خواهد بود.
examples.en: The water will be cold this morning.

examples.fr: Mon travail finira à six heures.
examples.fa: کارم ساعت شش تمام خواهد شد.
examples.en: My work will finish at six.

examples.fa: این شهر خیلی تغییر کرده است.
examples.en: This city has changed a lot.

examples.fr: La ville sera calme en août.
examples.fa: شهر در اوت آرام خواهد بود.
examples.en: The city will be quiet in August.

n:temps.usage: Le temps is both the time that passes and the weather.

examples.fr: Je n'ai pas eu le temps.
Cette femme a écrit trois livres.
examples.fa: این زن سه کتاب نوشته است.
examples.en: This woman has written three books.

examples.fr: La femme au guichet vous aidera.
examples.fa: زنِ پشت باجه به شما کمک خواهد کرد.
examples.en: The woman at the counter will help you.

examples.fr: Un homme a demandé ton adresse.
examples.en: A man asked for your address.
